description: Non-financial comparison inputs. Figures are an annual material flow and an approximate population, NOT owned/custodied ORD assets.

copper.source: Comisión Chilena del Cobre (COCHILCO), August 2026 Monthly Electronic Bulletin, Table 29, 2025 World Total 23,665.3 thousand metric tonnes copper content
copper.measurement: 2025 worldwide copper mine output, copper content; mined flow, not refined deliverable cathode

population.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024 medium-variant projection; round-number 2026 assumption rather than a live census
population.note: Approximate 8.3 billion for 2026, explicitly rounded; use revised UN data for precise headcount comparisons

delivery.source: London Metal Exchange, Copper Grade A physical contract specification
delivery.note: LME Grade A copper physical warrant 25 tonnes (plus/minus 2%), a wholesale contract; not a claim that ORD holders must redeem in LME lots
